source.notes: Stages from Skyrim.esm as patched by Update.esm, via xEdit. Questline grouping and order curated by hand against UESP. Verified 2026-09-11.

lines.title: Main Quest

quests.name: Season Unending
quests.note: Season Unending is the peace-council quest, and the game skips it on its own if the civil war is far enough along. Selecting it records the truce as brokered.

quests.name: Paarthurnax
quests.note: Completing this quest means Paarthurnax dies. If you'd rather he lived, leave this unchecked; the main quest completes fine without it.

lines.blurb: Alduin, the Greybeards, all of it. Complete it all, or stop partway and start your game as a mid-story Dragonborn.

lines.title: Civil War
lines.blurb: Pick ONE side here. For either side, 'Joining' and the 'Jagged Crown' are the only scriptable skips. The campaign battles beyond these reuse radiant quest records for every hold and both sides, so replaying their stages blind would corrupt the war's state. Play the campaign out, or sidestep the war with 'Season Unending' from the main quest.

lines.title: The Companions
lines.blurb: The Jorrvaskr line, 'Take Up Arms' through 'Glory of the Dead'. You end up Harbinger. Oh, and a werewolf.

lines.title: College of Winterhold

quests.name: Revealing the Unseen
quests.note: 'Revealing the Unseen' plays before 'Containment' despite the editor IDs.

lines.blurb: 'First Lessons' through 'The Eye of Magnus'. You end up Arch-Mage.

lines.title: College of Winterhold — Side Quests

quests.name: Arniel's Endeavor
quests.note: Part one of four.

lines.blurb: Arniel's Endeavor is a four-part series, in order. The apprentices' favors and the master-spell rituals are independent, so they're optional. The rituals normally unlock at skill 90 in their school.

lines.title: Thieves Guild

quests.name: Silver Lining
quests.note: City influence job (Windhelm). Normally unlocked by radiant jobs. All four are needed to become Guild Master.

quests.name: The Dainty Sload
quests.note: City influence job (Solitude).

quests.name: Imitation Amnesty
quests.note: City influence job (Whiterun).

quests.name: Summerset Shadows
quests.note: City influence job (Markarth).

quests.name: No Stone Unturned
quests.note: No Stone Unturned, Vex's Stones of Barenziah hunt.

quests.name: Under New Management
quests.note: Under New Management, the Guild Master capstone.

lines.blurb: 'A Chance Arrangement' through 'Darkness Returns', then the four city-influence jobs on the road to Guild Master. Click 'Darkness Returns' to stop there, or 'Under New Management' for the whole arc.

lines.title: The Dark Brotherhood

quests.name: Delayed Burial
quests.note: Delayed Burial, the Cicero wagon intro. Skippable.

quests.name: Contract: Kill Narfi
quests.note: Nazir's twelve fixed side contracts. Sets of these quests normally pace the main questline.

quests.name: Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head...
quests.note: Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head, the post-story sanctuary refurbish.

quests.name: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!
quests.note: Kill Astrid and wipe out the Sanctuary instead of joining.

lines.blurb: Innocence Lost through Hail Sithis! — or burn the whole thing down instead.

lines.title: Daedric Quests

quests.name: The Black Star
quests.note: Azura.

quests.name: Boethiah's Calling
quests.note: Boethiah.

quests.name: A Daedra's Best Friend
quests.note: Clavicus Vile.

quests.name: Discerning the Transmundane
quests.note: Hermaeus Mora. Ties into the main quest's Elder Knowledge.

quests.name: Ill Met By Moonlight
quests.note: Hircine.

quests.name: The Cursed Tribe
quests.note: Malacath.

quests.name: Pieces of the Past
quests.note: Mehrunes Dagon.

quests.name: The Whispering Door
quests.note: Mephala.

quests.name: The Break of Dawn
quests.note: Meridia.

quests.name: The House of Horrors
quests.note: Molag Bal.

quests.name: The Taste of Death
quests.note: Namira.

quests.name: The Only Cure
quests.note: Peryite.

quests.name: A Night To Remember
quests.note: Sanguine.

quests.name: The Mind of Madness
quests.note: Sheogorath.

quests.name: Waking Nightmare
quests.note: Vaermina.

lines.blurb: Independent artifact quests, unordered, all optional.

lines.title: City Side Quests

quests.name: The Forsworn Conspiracy
quests.note: Leads into No One Escapes Cidhna Mine.

quests.name: The Man Who Cried Wolf
quests.note: The Man Who Cried Wolf, part one of the Wolf Queen story.

quests.name: The Wolf Queen Awakened
quests.note: Part two; select The Man Who Cried Wolf as well.

quests.name: Blood on the Ice
quests.note: Part two of Blood on the Ice; select part one as well.

quests.name: Repairing the Phial
quests.note: Repairing the Phial follows The White Phial; select it as well.

quests.name: Rising at Dawn
quests.note: Rising at Dawn, Falion's vampirism cure.

lines.blurb: Standalone side quests, unordered, all optional.

lines.title: Bards College
lines.blurb: Tending the Flames makes you a Bard. The instrument hunts are independent extras.

lines.title: Dungeon Quests

quests.name: Forbidden Legend
quests.note: Forbidden Legend spans three dungeons and ends at the Gauldur amulet.

lines.blurb: Self-contained dungeon quests, unordered, all optional.
